profile.subtitleJa: エルサレム神殿の門の呼称
profile.summaryJa: エルサレム神殿域の門として記されるが、門の考古学的同定には議論があり、座標は特定できない。使徒3:2では、物乞いをする人が神殿の「美しい」と呼ばれる門のそばに置かれていた
profile.modernLocationJa: エルサレム神殿域の門として記されるが、門の考古学的同定には議論があり、座標は特定できない。

profile.locationNoteJa: 候補座標は未採用。地理記述は概略に留め、Pleiades公式固定データまたは考古学機関でこの対象を照合できていないため座標はnull。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 本文の地名言及は確認。関係は地名の出身地・地域・行程からの関連づけで、出来事の地点とは限らない。原文要旨: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

WEB固定版の使徒3:10で地名・場所の出現を確認。原文要旨: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

review.identityCheckJa: place:beautiful_gate_163 は「Beautiful gate」の場所用例。割当済みのActs出現を本文ごとに確認し、relatedは出身地・行政地域・地名からの関係として限定。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 紹介文とhistoricalRoleJaは初出の使徒3:2に限定。後続の関連用例は箇所リストに留め、追加情報は記述していない。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article identifies the Beautiful Gate as a Jerusalem Temple gate in Acts 3:2,10; its physical-location section says identification is unsettled and lists Nicanor and Shushan as proposed candidates.
